name: PRD 3.1 / 3.3 / 3.4: NSF, Late and Admin fee screens expose their fields
description:
Objective: NSF, Late and Admin fee screens expose their PRD fields.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA is available; the configured authorized Admin account can access Application & Deal Rules. Tests are read-only and must not submit configuration changes or create applications.
Steps:
1. Open each fee screen.
2. Verify table columns.
3. Open Add: verify required fields and From Date; submit disabled.
4. Cancel.
Expected: Each screen exposes its PRD fields; incomplete forms cannot be submitted (PRD 3.1, 3.3, 3.4).
